dex.entry: A sturdy tortoise-like creature whose shell is made of compressed bark and stone. It sleeps for weeks, growing new bark-rings like a tree. A living tree-stump that turns out to be a baby — the double-take moment when it opens its eyes.

art.silhouette: Tiny squat form, rounded bark-ring shell like a tree cross-section, four stubby rock-grey legs, a small snout peering out; looks like a living tree stump.
